kind: post hoc offline interpretation; no extra model calls
trigger: GSQ W02 delivered three nonempty lines, each with its source marker, but runner.py:49 counted only blank-line-separated blocks. The prompt asks for three paragraphs without specifying blank lines.
scope: every recorded W02 answer in main, thinking-complex and native-sampling on all admitted models and hardware, including unchanged and failed outcomes
compatibility_rule: Normalize CRLF and CR to LF. If the text contains blank-line paragraph separators, use those paragraph blocks; otherwise count the nonempty lines. Require exactly three. Keep all other original hard checks, editorial threshold, budgets and timing rules unchanged.
reporting: Show original frozen pass and supplementary paragraph-compatible pass separately. A single-newline answer must not be described as lacking three paragraphs when it has three nonempty paragraphs. Neither total nor recommendation may silently replace the original score. No outputs are edited.
timestamp_source: registration document creation time on the collecting host, before the first offline compatibility run
